new_today_news.headline: Update to Landfill Tipping Fees
new_today_news.summary: Tift County Landfill announced increases in tipping fees effective August 1, 2026, reflecting rising operational costs and future capital improvements.

backfill_news.headline: IRS Issues 45Z Tax Credit Notice and DOE Updates 45ZCF-GREET Model
backfill_news.summary: The IRS published Notice 2026-53 on September 8, 2026, providing calendar year 2026 emissions rates for Section 45Z clean fuel production credit, including provisions for used cooking oil (UCO) and fats, oils, greases feedstock. The September 2026 version of the 45ZCF-GREET model integrates USDA's final Framework for Determining Carbon Intensity of Crops and restricts post-2025 fuel production to feedstock from the U.S., Canada, or Mexico—eliminating eligibility for imported UCO.
